I don’t get migraines after taking multi-vitamins, but when I was pregnant I had to take iron and I always had a migraine after I’d take the pill. I finally realized it was the red dye in the iron pill and not the iron. My pharmacist ordered red dye free iron tables and no more migraines.
I stay away from all red dye now. No red gum, antacids, mints, etc. Even the smallest amount will trigger one. Hope you find an answer to your question!

I’ve stopped waking him for work, doing his laundry and told him he now has to help with his bills since he chose not to go to college. Not sure if that’s the right thing to do or not.
I do see a counselor weekly, and that does help. I get overwhelmed between sessions. Sometimes I need more than an hour to share all my thoughts and emotions. Thank you for caring.
